backup.production_rule: s116 (Lloyd 2026-11-15): staff_guest_card_v1 gains one key, id_photo_name: btrim(name) of the guest_companions row whose id_photo_path is the guest primary ID photo (the row id_face_box is read from), under the same gate as id_photo_path (guest given and staff_may_see_guest_id_v1), else null. It reaches the Staff app through staff_home_v1 existing merge of staff_guest_card_v1 (no change there). Every other key and line of the s115 body is unchanged. The orchestrator re-stamps restore_point and verified_at on the fresh backup taken before the apply.
backup.notes: Phase backfill is the house label for a function body; no table, column, row, trigger or other function changes. One function body is replaced (guarded by the md5 of the live s115 body, 4405ec514a941053bd25160936fc0926) and its grants are restated (service_role only). Expected live effect: the card of a guest whose only ID photo is a companion now carries that companion name; older readers ignore the extra key. Second migration 20261115000100_s116_item_photo_options.sql (lane S2): widens the inventory_item_options source_url check to mandauefoam.ph and myhanabishi.com, adds suppliers Mandaue Foam and Hanabishi, inserts 51 item-photo options (never usual or preferred, no price); the insert raises unless each item name matches exactly one active item. Its rollback deletes only those 51 pairs and the two suppliers when unreferenced, then restores the check.
